In Jewish law there is room for immersion in natural bodies of water such as the ocean.
There are numerous stipulations, not in the scope of this book. In the case where it is absolutely
impossible to go to a mikveh and she must immerse in a natural body of water, she must do so
only under the exact directions of an orthodox Rabbi expert in these laws. However, it must be
emphasized that there are many stipulations to be clarified.
Following are important suggestions directed to those supervising the mikveh. They are
meant to facilitate a more pleasurable and efficient experience for the women using the
mikveh, as well as to lighten the job of those working there, making the whole experience as
The following should be kept in abundant supply.
Acetone for nail polish removal. Purchasing quality acetone, although more
costly, is preferable. It lightens the wife’s work in removing her nail polish,
alleviates the ‘Mikveh-lady’s’ helping her, and thus speeds up the efficiency of the
mikveh. The acetone should be kept closed, to retain its strength. Bleach to remove
Hand cream for women after their immersion, especially in the winter.
Appropriate and sufficient mirrors should be supplied. Preferably the ability to
view her back also (through two mirrors) should be offered.
It is important to design proper water drainage from the bathrooms. This will lighten the job
of whomever is responsible for cleaning. It is also important to ensure that the sinks have
working plugs. This is especially important to women with contact lenses.
Wise delegation of duties should be exercised regarding cleaning the bathrooms between
women and at the end of the night. In mikvehs with a lot of clientele, one should weigh the
wisdom of expecting the ‘Mikveh-lady’ to be responsible for this.
Working fans should be in place during the summer, as well as proper air circulation.
Proper lighting is also important. The baths should not be too narrow, to ease use by larger
women. Hand rails should be available to allow women to enter and leave the bathtub easily.
